startAsNewTrace.description:
By default, the current trace will be associated with the newly created span.
Setting this to true will ensure that a new trace is created and associated with the newly created span.

disableExceptionRecording.description:
If true, the span will not record exceptions.
By default, exception will be recorded based on the {@link Observability.Tracer.Config#disableExceptionRecording}.
